participants.description: A person reading KFD decisions, philosophy, and release evidence.
An agent consuming KFD registry, standards metadata, schemas, and package exports.
A human or agent maintaining KFD decisions, metadata, package surfaces, and release evidence.
A participant proposing, challenging, implementing, or supplying evidence for KFD work without requiring kungfu-systems affiliation.
A project, product, organization, or research group declaring an independent KFD adoption scope and owning its implementation evidence.
A participant reviewing KFD claims, qualification evidence, compatibility impact, or governance without authoring the reviewed change.
A downstream repository consuming the @kungfu-tech/kfd package.
A site repository consuming KFD's site bundle, registry, standards metadata, and decision text.
A release system consuming KFD witnesses, impact ledgers, and release propagation contracts.

Inspect the shared notation, authority boundary, and traceability contract for non-normative KFD formal references.
Test the KFD primitive-discovery lens against source-bound historical cases without changing normative KFD text.
Discover provisional Primitive candidates, immutable KFD-5 cuts, claim boundaries, and open review paths without treating a live case as a numbered decision.
Discover non-normative pre-number KFD Candidates, non-binding slot hints, promotion gates, and claim boundaries.
Route readers and agents to the right KFD document or machine surface.
Propose, challenge, implement, qualify, review, or revise KFD work through the public evidence process.
Understand open participation, canonical stewardship, decision authority, conflicts, and maintainer succession.
Understand what Apache-2.0 covers and what remains official, trademark-bound, or endorsement-bound.
Consume the authoritative decision index.
Discover KFD schema IDs, schema paths, concepts, and interface contracts.
Consume the shipped npm package surfaces.
Inspect the explicit KFD package version anchor for the current Buildchain release line.
Inspect the explicit public KFD-2 claim passed into Buildchain release passport generation.
Inspect generic KFD-2 claims for the KFD package self-dogfood assessment.
Inspect KFD-2's generic assessment of KFD-1 and KFD-3 through KFD-7 claims.
Render KFD-owned homepage, foundation explanation, formal references, historical and live cases, and decision pages without duplicating extraction logic.

valueEvidence.claim: KFD helps humans and agents understand the KFD Foundation and inspect precise non-normative formal references before adopting or extending KFD decisions.

residualRisk.reason: The foundation and formal models are published and inspectable, but their full human-language meaning cannot be exhaustively proved from package bytes.

valueEvidence.claim: KFD gives agents and release systems machine-readable standards, schemas, package exports, and witnesses so they can consume KFD without relying on private context.
KFD gives humans and agents an inspectable path from provisional Primitive genesis through immutable KFD-5 cuts and open qualification without promoting the candidate by self-certification.

residualRisk.reason: Machine checks can validate case structure, immutable cut identity, and declared status, but cannot prove Primitive truth, propagation power, or method superiority.

valueEvidence.claim: KFD gives humans and agents a shared, machine-readable path for preserving pre-number candidates, recording explicit promotion into KFD-7, and keeping remaining slot hints non-binding.

residualRisk.reason: Machine checks can prove candidate identity, status, slot non-binding, promotion lineage, and numbering boundaries, but cannot prove semantic qualification of an unpromoted candidate or activation of a promoted numbered draft.

valueEvidence.claim: KFD gives humans and agents a visible public path to propose, challenge, implement, adopt, or review the standard when a decision, interface, or taxonomy is insufficient.

transparentConstraints.constraint: Before stable, fully evidenced foundation correction preserves published coordinates and lineage; after Foundation Freeze, substantive semantic changes supersede older KFD numbers instead of changing them in place.
transparentConstraints.reason: Decision history and the current number-to-meaning mapping must remain inspectable by humans and agents.

transparentConstraints.constraint: Any participant may propose, challenge, implement, adopt, or review KFD work; only accountable maintainers may change official numbering, status, and releases through public evidence and review.
transparentConstraints.reason: KFD must remain externally corrigible without making canonical authority ambiguous.

transparentConstraints.constraint: KFD owns homepage text, foundation explanation, decision text, registry, and standards metadata; the site owns rendering style and layout.
transparentConstraints.reason: Text remains a single fact source while the site stays free to render it.

transparentConstraints.constraint: Public package surfaces must be explicitly exported and verified.
transparentConstraints.reason: Agents and downstream repositories should not rely on hidden package internals.

transparentConstraints.constraint: KFD provides decisions, standards metadata, schemas, and witnesses; it does not provide the Kungfu runtime, GUI, or CLI.
transparentConstraints.reason: KFD should remain a standard/decision package, not a product runtime.

choicePaths.choice: Read README.md, docs/foundation.md, docs/formal-model.md, docs/MAP.md, decisions/*.md, docs/KFD-N-formal.md, pre-number candidates through drafts/registry.json, and provisional cases through cases/registry.json directly.
Consume registry.json, drafts/registry.json, standards.json, schemas, and package exports.
Consume site/kfd-site.json and own rendering/style decisions downstream.
Change KFD through PR review, node scripts/check.mjs, and Buildchain release gates.
Use GitHub issues and pull requests to propose, challenge, implement, qualify, or review KFD work under CONTRIBUTING.md and GOVERNANCE.md.

extensionRequests.trigger: A participant has a proposed KFD Candidate, amendment, counterexample, adopter Profile, implementation result, or governance improvement.

requestPath.template: Choose the proposal, counterevidence, or adopter Profile issue form and declare the claim boundary, evidence, counterevidence, applicability, interests, and requested outcome.

extensionRequests.expectedOutcome: Maintainers publicly qualify, revise, route, reject, or advance the contribution against KFD evidence and governance requirements.

extensionRequests.trigger: A human or agent needs a residual-risk, trust-impact, machine-provability, agent-action, or downgrade-reason value that is not present in schemas/kfd-2/trust-taxonomy.schema.json.

requestPath.template: State the missing value, the taxonomy field, the product or release scenario, and why existing KFD-2 values cannot express the case.

extensionRequests.expectedOutcome: KFD maintainers either add the value to the KFD-2 trust taxonomy schema or explain which existing value should be used.

closure.reachableSurfaceSource: This file plus package.json#exports, CONTRIBUTING.md, GOVERNANCE.md, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*.yml, .github/pull_request_template.md, docs/foundation.md, docs/formal-model.md, docs/KFD-*-formal.md, docs/MAP.md, cases/registry.json, drafts/registry.json, registry.json, standards.json, and Buildchain witness files.
